name: graph_paths
description: A weighted graph with Dijkstra shortest paths, BFS reachability, connected components and directed cycle detection.
bugs: dijkstra() only sets a distance the first time a node is discovered instead of relaxing to a smaller one
add_edge() keeps the minimum only for u->v; the reverse direction of an undirected edge is overwritten with the new weight
has_cycle() treats any already-visited (black) node as a cycle, so DAGs with shared descendants report cycles
